Title: Lesson 1 - Red Light Patience
Description: You are stuck at a busy junction. NPC cars honk aggressively behind you. A family of four is crossing the road — wait for them to reach the other side before you move.
Practical: Wait at the red light. Let all pedestrians cross. Do not move until the light turns green.
Hints: Stop behind the solid white stop line at signals. | Wait for all pedestrians to fully cross before accelerating. | Ignore impatient honking from NPCs — they will not get a challan; you will.

Title: Lesson 2 - Street Parking
Description: In busy Mumbai streets; finding legal parking is a challenge. NPCs routinely double-park and block footpaths.
Practical: Find the legal parking spot 50 meters ahead. Park there and walk to the shop objective.
Hints: School zones have a 20 km/h speed limit — reduce speed well before entering. | Children may dart out from between parked cars without looking. | Activate your hazard lights to warn NPCs behind you.

Title: Lesson 3 - Ambulance on a Busy Road
Description: Emergency vehicles need a clear path. On a busy road; your quick reaction can save a life.
Practical: Pull over left and stop when you hear the ambulance siren. Do not move until it passes.
Hints: Pull over left immediately when you hear sirens — don't wait for the ambulance to be right behind you. | Stop completely; not just slow down. The ambulance needs a clear lane. | NPCs ahead may panic and swerve — stay predictable.

Title: Lesson 4 - Puddle on the Main Road
Description: After heavy rain; puddles form along footpath edges where pedestrians walk. Your speed determines the splash radius.
Practical: Slow down before the puddle. Pass pedestrians at walking pace without splashing them.
Hints: Slow down well before you reach a puddle — braking in it sends water everywhere. | If pedestrians are near the edge; crawl past at walking pace. | NPCs will speed through and splash everyone. Don't be them.

Title: Lesson 5 - School Zone Crossing
Description: You are approaching a school zone during dismissal time. Children in uniforms are crossing randomly between parked cars. Slow down and give them priority.
Practical: Drive slowly through the school zone. Stop if children are crossing. Do not honk near the school.
Hints: School zones have a 20 km/h speed limit — reduce speed well before entering. | Children may dart out from between parked cars without looking. | Activate your hazard lights to warn NPCs behind you.

Title: Lesson 6 - Hospital Zone Parking
Description: You are near a hospital entrance. NPC ambulances need clear access. Do not park within 100 meters of the hospital gate — find a spot further away.
Practical: Drive past the hospital. Park in a legal spot at least 100 meters away. Walk back.
Hints: Hospitals have a strict no-parking zone within 100 meters of the entrance. | Ambulances need turning space — do not block driveways. | Patient drop-off zones are for temporary stops only — do not linger.

Title: Lesson 7 - Hospital Zone Silence
Description: You are driving past a hospital. A 'Silence Zone' sign is visible. An NPC ahead is braking suddenly. Do not honk — slow down and maintain distance.
Law Section: MV Act Section 118 & Noise Pollution Rules
Practical: Do not honk. Slow down; maintain distance; and drive silently past the hospital.
Hints: Hospitals are legally declared Silence Zones — honking is banned. | Maintain extra following distance to avoid sudden braking. | Patients recovering need quiet — your horn disrupts their recovery.

Title: Lesson 8 - Narrow Street Ambulance
Description: An ambulance is stuck behind you on a narrow single-lane street. There is no room to pull over. Find a gap between parked cars or a driveway to squeeze into.
Practical: Find a gap between parked cars. Signal; maneuver into it; and let the ambulance pass.
Hints: On narrow streets; you may need to mount the curb slightly to create space. | Look for driveways; alleys; or gaps between parked cars. | Signal your intention before maneuvering — honk once to alert pedestrians.

Title: Lesson 9 - Puddle at a Bus Stop
Description: A bus stop is flooded. Commuters are huddled under the shelter; but some are wading through ankle-deep water to reach the road. You must not splash them.
Practical: Wait for commuters to board the bus or clear the road. Pass slowly when the way is clear.
Hints: Bus stops concentrate pedestrians — be extra cautious. | Ankle-deep water means a large splash at even low speeds. | Wait for commuters to clear the road before passing.

Title: Lesson 10 - Market Area Parking
Description: A crowded market area with vendors spilling onto the road. NPC auto-rickshaws are parked haphazardly. Navigate through carefully and find a designated parking zone.
Law Section: Municipal Corp Bye-laws & MV Act Section 122
Practical: Navigate through the market carefully. Park in the designated paid zone. Walk to your destination.
Hints: Market vendors have the right to their stall space — do not push them aside. | Auto-rickshaws may pull out without warning — keep a safe distance. | Designated parking zones are marked with blue signs.

Title: Lesson 11 - Library Zone
Description: You are passing a public library. Students are studying near open windows. An NPC is blocking the road ahead. Resist the urge to honk — wait patiently.
Law Section: MV Act Section 118 & Noise Pollution Rules
Practical: Wait patiently for the NPC to move. Do not honk near the library.
Hints: Libraries are quiet zones — honking disrupts students and readers. | The NPC blocking the road will eventually move — do not pressure them. | Use your horn only in genuine emergencies; not for convenience.

Title: Lesson 12 - Highway Ambulance
Description: You are on a multi-lane highway. An ambulance approaches at high speed from behind. Move to the leftmost lane and maintain speed — do not stop suddenly.
Practical: Indicate left; merge to the left lane; maintain your speed; and let the ambulance pass.
Hints: On highways; do not stop suddenly — move to the left lane and maintain speed. | Use your indicator before changing lanes. | Stay in the left lane until the ambulance has fully passed.

Title: Lesson 13 - Night Rain Puddles
Description: It is raining at night. Puddles are hard to see in the dark. A pedestrian with a broken umbrella is walking on the road edge. You may not see the puddle until it is too late.
Practical: Drive slowly; scan for water reflections; and give pedestrians a wide berth in the dark.
Hints: At night; puddles are nearly invisible — assume they are everywhere near footpaths. | Use your headlights to scan for water reflections. | If you see a pedestrian on the road; slow down regardless of puddles.

Title: Lesson 14 - Night Crossing
Description: It is late at night. Visibility is poor. An elderly person with a walking stick is slowly crossing at an unmarked crossing point. NPCs are speeding past — do not follow them.
Practical: Slow down; use headlights responsibly; and wait for the elderly person to cross completely.
Hints: Use your headlights properly — dip them for oncoming traffic. | At unmarked crossings; pedestrians still have the right of way. | Reduce speed at night — reaction times are halved in low visibility.

Title: Lesson 15 - Residential Parking
Description: You are in a residential colony. A resident is blocking your path; pointing at your bumper — you are parked in front of their gate. Move your car to a visitor parking spot.
Practical: Move your car immediately. Park in the visitor parking zone. Walk to the objective.
Hints: Never park in front of someone's gate — it blocks their entry/exit. | Residential colonies often have designated visitor parking spots. | Apologize and move immediately if a resident complains.

Title: Lesson 16 - Residential Night
Description: It is late at night in a residential colony. Your GPS is leading you through narrow lanes. A sleeping dog is lying in the middle of the road. Do not honk to wake it — slowly go around.
Law Section: Noise Pollution Rules & MV Act Section 118
Practical: Drive slowly around the sleeping dog. Do not honk. Reach the main road quietly.
Hints: Night honking in residential areas violates noise regulations. | A sleeping dog may wake startled and run under your wheels. | Use your horn only if there is an immediate safety threat.

Title: Lesson 17 - Traffic Jam Ambulance
Description: Complete gridlock. An ambulance is trapped in the jam behind you. NPC drivers are not moving. You must create a path by inching forward and pulling as far left as possible.
Practical: Turn on hazard lights. Inch forward. Pull left. Keep creating space until the ambulance passes.
Hints: Even in a jam; inch forward to create space ahead. | Pull as far left as possible — even onto the curb if safe. | Hazard lights on to warn traffic behind you.

Title: Lesson 18 - School Zone Puddles
Description: School children in uniforms are walking through puddles on their way home. They are in groups; chatting; and not paying attention to traffic. Slow down to a crawl.
Practical: Crawl through the school zone. Wait for children to clear your path. Do not splash them.
Hints: School children are easily distracted — they may change direction suddenly. | A splash on a school child is worse than on an adult — they are more vulnerable. | School zones have speed limits even in rain — 20 km/h maximum.

Title: Lesson 19 - Festival Crowd
Description: A festival procession has spilled onto the road. There are no traffic signals working — a police volunteer is directing traffic manually. Follow their signals exactly.
Practical: Follow the traffic volunteer's signals. Crawl through the crowd. Do not honk.
Hints: Follow the traffic volunteer's hand signals — they override broken signals. | Festival crowds are unpredictable — maintain a crawling speed. | Do not honk — it will only agitate the crowd and create panic.

Title: Lesson 20 - Temple & Prayer Zone
Description: You are driving past a temple during evening aarti. Devotees are gathered outside. A cow is sitting in the road. This is the ultimate test of your patience — no honking; no rushing.
Law Section: MV Act Section 118 & Religious Place Rules
Practical: Wait for the cow to move. Drive past the temple slowly and silently. Do not honk under any circumstances.
Hints: Temples are declared quiet zones during prayer hours. | Cows have the right of way in India — literally and legally. | Honking near a place of worship is deeply disrespectful.

Title: Lesson 21 - Signal Discipline
Description: You approach a busy intersection with multiple signals. A delivery truck jumps the red light ahead of you. Stay disciplined — follow the rules even when others don't.
Practical: Wait for the signal to turn green. Check all directions before proceeding. Do not follow the truck.
Hints: Never follow a vehicle that jumps a red light. | Always check all directions before proceeding on green. | Yellow means slow down and prepare to stop; not speed up.

Title: Lesson 22 - Road Rage Control
Description: A taxi driver cut you off aggressively. You feel angry. But road rage never helps — stay calm; give space; and drive safely.
Practical: Stay calm. Give the taxi extra space. Do not honk back or tailgate. Drive safely to destination.
Hints: Road rage leads to accidents and legal trouble. | Give aggressive drivers extra space to avoid confrontation. | Horn abuse and tailgating escalate situations.

Title: Lesson 23 - Heavy Rain Driving
Description: Heavy rain is falling. Visibility is poor; roads are flooded; and pedestrians are running for cover. Slow down and use your headlights.
Practical: Turn on low beam headlights. Slow down to half speed. Avoid all puddles. Use hazard lights if visibility is very low.
Hints: Use low beam headlights in rain — high beam reflects off water. | Increase following distance by 2x in wet conditions. | Puddles can hide deep potholes — never drive through fast.

Title: Lesson 24 - Pedestrian Priority
Description: An elderly person is trying to cross the road at a zebra crossing. Traffic is flowing but you must stop and let them cross safely.
Practical: Stop at the zebra crossing. Wait patiently for the elderly person to cross completely. Do not honk.
Hints: Pedestrians always have right of way at zebra crossings. | Elderly and disabled pedestrians need extra patience. | Stopping for pedestrians saves lives — never rush them.

Title: Lesson 25 - Know Your Signs!
Description: You encounter three types of road signs: blue mandatory signs; red cautionary signs; and green informational signs. Each requires a different response.
Practical: Obey the blue mandatory sign. Slow down for the red cautionary sign. Read the green informational sign.
Hints: Blue signs tell you what you MUST do. | Red signs warn you of dangers ahead. | Green signs provide information about distances and locations.

Title: Lesson 26 - Cows on the Road!
Description: A cow is sitting right in the middle of the road. Cars behind you are honking. But cows are sacred in India — never honk at them; just wait patiently.
Practical: Stop and wait patiently. Do not honk. Give the cow space. Pass only when it moves clear.
Hints: Cows have right of way in India — legally and culturally. | Never honk at a cow — it may panic and cause an accident. | Wait patiently; cows usually move on their own within a minute.

Title: Lesson 27 - Narrow Street!
Description: You enter a narrow residential street. An auto-rickshaw is coming from the opposite direction. There's barely room for both — crawl at walking pace and find a gap.
Practical: Crawl at walking pace. Signal the auto to let them know you're there. Find a wider spot and let the auto pass first.
Hints: Narrow streets require crawling speed — walking pace or slower. | Look for wider spots where you can yield. | Horn use is acceptable on blind narrow streets to warn oncoming traffic.

Title: Lesson 28 - Parking Rules!
Description: You need to park near a shopping area. A fire hydrant is visible; a no-parking zone is marked; and a legal parking spot is further away. Choose wisely.
Practical: Drive past the hydrant and no-parking zone. Park in the designated parking zone. Walk to your destination.
Hints: Never park within 5 meters of a fire hydrant. | Blue "P" signs mark legal parking zones. | Illegal parking near hydrants can result in heavy fines.

Title: Lesson 29 - Auto-Rickshaw Dance!
Description: You're driving behind an auto-rickshaw. It keeps stopping suddenly; swerving to pick up passengers; and making unpredictable moves. Stay alert and maintain safe distance.
Practical: Maintain 3 car lengths behind the auto. Stop when it stops. Do not overtake until the road is completely clear.
Hints: Auto-rickshaws stop frequently and unpredictably. | Maintain at least 3 car lengths distance behind autos. | Never overtake an auto near a bus stop or crossing.

Title: Lesson 30 - Toll Plaza!
Description: You approach a highway toll plaza. Choose the correct lane (FASTag or cash); slow down; stop at the booth; and pay the toll.
Practical: Slow down on approach. Choose the correct lane. Stop at the booth and pay. Proceed on the highway.
Hints: FASTag lanes are marked with blue signs — most vehicles use these. | Cash lanes are for vehicles without FASTag. | Always slow down when approaching a toll plaza.

Title: Lesson 31 - Blind Corner!
Description: You approach a blind corner where you cannot see oncoming traffic. Honk once to warn others; then crawl around the corner.
Practical: Honk once before the corner. Crawl around the corner at walking speed. Yield to any oncoming vehicle.
Hints: Blind corners are one of the most dangerous road situations. | One short honk warns oncoming traffic of your presence. | Crawl around blind corners — never drive at full speed.

Title: Lesson 32 - Hill Driving!
Description: You're driving up a steep hill with hairpin bends. Use low gear uphill; honk at blind hairpin bends; and engine brake downhill.
Practical: Use low gear uphill. Honk at every hairpin bend. Engine brake downhill. Reach the top safely.
Hints: Low gear uphill gives more power and control. | Engine braking downhill prevents brake overheating. | Always honk at hairpin bends — you cannot see around them.

Title: Lesson 33 - Bus Stop Yield!
Description: A bus is stopped at a bus stop picking up passengers. You must wait behind the bus and never overtake near a bus stop — passengers may cross unexpectedly.
Practical: Stop behind the bus. Wait for passengers to cross. Do not overtake until the bus moves away.
Hints: Passengers may cross the road immediately after getting off a bus. | Never overtake a bus at or near a bus stop. | Wait until the bus moves and the road is clear.

Title: Lesson 34 - Construction Zone!
Description: A construction zone blocks part of the road. Follow the detour signs; obey the flagman; and slow down through the zone.
Practical: Slow down to 20 km/h. Follow the detour signs. Obey the flagman. Exit the construction zone carefully.
Hints: Construction zones have strict speed limits — usually 20 km/h. | Temporary signs and flagmen override normal traffic rules. | Fines in construction zones are often doubled.

Title: Lesson 35 - One-Way Wonder!
Description: You approach a one-way street. Enter from the correct end; follow the flow of traffic; and exit at the intersection. Never go against traffic.
Practical: Enter the one-way from the correct end. Follow the traffic flow. Exit at the designated intersection.
Hints: One-way streets have a single direction of travel. | Entering from the wrong end is extremely dangerous. | Look for one-way signs (blue rectangular signs with arrow).

Title: Lesson 36 - Sign Recognition!
Description: A complex intersection presents three sign types simultaneously. Identify mandatory (blue); cautionary (red); and informational (green) signs and respond to each correctly.
Practical: Identify and obey the mandatory sign. Slow down for the cautionary sign. Use the informational sign for navigation.
Hints: Blue = Mandatory — you MUST follow the instruction. | Red = Cautionary — slow down and be alert. | Green = Informational — helps with navigation.

Title: Lesson 37 - Hospital Quiet Zone!
Description: You're driving past a hospital. Absolutely no honking. Slow down; watch for ambulances entering/exiting; and leave the zone quietly.
Practical: Drive through the hospital zone silently. No honking under any circumstances. Watch for ambulances and yield immediately.
Hints: Hospital zones have zero tolerance for honking. | Ambulances may enter or exit at any moment. | Fines in hospital zones are among the highest.

Title: Lesson 38 - Festival Traffic!
Description: A festival procession blocks part of the road. Diversion signs are placed. Expect unexpected crowds; music vehicles; and pedestrians everywhere.
Practical: Yield to the procession. Follow the diversion route. Drive extremely slowly through the crowd. Reach your destination.
Hints: Festival traffic creates unusual road patterns. | Follow diversion signs — they lead to alternate routes. | Yield to festival processions — they have priority.

Title: Lesson 39 - Cyclist Safety!
Description: A cyclist is riding on the left side of the road. You need to pass safely with at least 1 meter of space. Never overtake near an intersection.
Practical: Maintain 1 meter space when passing. Do not overtake near intersections. Wait for a clear; safe opportunity.
Hints: Give cyclists at least 1 meter of space when passing. | Never overtake a cyclist near an intersection or turning. | Cyclists may swerve to avoid potholes — expect the unexpected.

Title: Lesson 40 - Grand Test!
Description: The ultimate test! Apply everything you've learned from 39 levels. Navigate a complex route with signals; pedestrians; speed limits; lane discipline; and emergency vehicles.
Practical: Complete the complex route following all traffic rules. Apply everything from the previous 39 levels. Stay calm and focused.
Hints: Apply all traffic rules you've learned so far. | Stay calm under pressure — multiple challenges at once. | This test covers all Tier 1-3 skills.

Title: Lesson 41 - Night Monsoon Grid!
Description: Drive through heavy monsoon rain at night. Zero visibility; flooded roads; and complex intersections. Use headlights and extreme caution.
Practical: Navigate the flooded night grid. Use headlights wisely. Crawl through puddles. Complete all intersections without stalling.
Hints: Night rain reduces visibility to near zero — use headlights. | Flooded roads may hide deep potholes — crawl through. | Intersection navigation requires memorizing road layout ahead of time.

Title: Lesson 42 - Wrong-Side Danger!
Description: Other vehicles are driving on the wrong side! Navigate carefully; predict their movements; and reach the destination without collision.
Practical: Stay in your lane. Predict wrong-side vehicle movements. Use horn to alert. Reach destination without collision.
Hints: Wrong-side drivers are unpredictable — expect anything. | Stay in your lane and signal intentions clearly. | Use horn sparingly to alert wrong-side drivers.

Title: Lesson 43 - Highway Merge Chaos!
Description: Merge onto a busy highway with heavy truck and bus traffic. Match speed; find gaps; and merge smoothly without causing accidents.
Practical: Match speed on the ramp. Check blind spot. Find a gap and merge. Do not linger beside trucks.
Hints: Match highway speed before merging — never merge slow. | Check mirrors AND blind spot before changing lanes. | Trucks have large blind spots — never linger beside them.

Title: Lesson 44 - Construction Maze!
Description: Road construction blocks your lane. Follow diversion signs through narrow temporary paths while avoiding workers and equipment.
Practical: Slow to 20 km/h. Follow diversion signs. Avoid workers and equipment. Complete the construction zone.
Hints: Construction zones have 20 km/h speed limits. | Workers may step onto the road unexpectedly. | Follow diversion signs — they lead to alternate routes.

Title: Lesson 45 - Zero Visibility!
Description: Dense fog at night with rain. You can barely see 10 meters ahead. Use fog lights; crawl at minimum speed; and trust your instincts.
Practical: Turn on fog lights. Crawl at minimum speed. Use horn to alert others. Navigate by sound and road markings.
Hints: Fog lights are mandatory — use them; not headlights. | Reduce speed to minimum — you cannot see what is ahead. | Listen for other vehicles — sound travels further than sight in fog.

Title: Lesson 46 - Festival Night Parade!
Description: Night-time festival procession with lights; music; and crowds spilling onto the road. Navigate through Diwali celebrations safely.
Practical: Yield to the procession. Find an alternate route. Avoid distracted pedestrians. Complete safely.
Hints: Festival night = distracted pedestrians everywhere. | Procession has priority — find an alternate route if needed. | Decorative lights can be distracting — focus on the road.

Title: Lesson 47 - Mountain Pass!
Description: Navigate a treacherous mountain road with hairpin turns; steep gradients; and falling rocks. Brake management and patience are key.
Practical: Use lower gears on descents. Horn at blind curves. Avoid road edge. Complete the mountain pass.
Hints: Use lower gears on steep descents — brakes can overheat. | Honk at blind curves to warn oncoming traffic. | Stay away from the edge — landslides can happen without warning.

Title: Lesson 48 - Rural Kacha Road!
Description: A narrow unpaved village road with potholes; stray animals; and oncoming tractors. Patience and spatial awareness are everything.
Practical: Crawl on the unpaved road. Honk to move animals. Give tractors space. Reach the village safely.
Hints: Kacha roads have hidden potholes — crawl at all times. | Cows and dogs may be sleeping on the road. | Tractors need wide turns — give them space.

Title: Lesson 49 - Multi-Modal Chaos!
Description: Every type of vehicle on the road at once — buses; trucks; autos; bikes; cycles; and pedestrians. The ultimate chaos management test.
Practical: Maintain safe distance from all vehicle types. Predict auto and bike movements. Navigate through the chaos.
Hints: Each vehicle type has different blind spots and turning patterns. | Buses stop suddenly — keep distance. | Autos and bikes weave unpredictably — expect sudden lane changes.

Title: Lesson 50 - Grand Mastery!
Description: THE ULTIMATE TEST. All weather conditions; all vehicle types; all road types; all traffic situations. Only a master driver can pass this.
Practical: Complete the ultimate test. Apply every skill from all previous levels. Stay calm; stay safe; stay respectful.
Hints: This test combines every skill from 49 levels. | Stay calm — panic is the real enemy. | Patience and observation beat speed every time.

Title: Lesson 51 - Lane Discipline
Description: A multi-lane highway with heavy truck and bus traffic. You must stay in your lane; overtake only from the right side (India drives left); and use indicators before changing lanes. Weaving between lanes is dangerous!
Practical: Stay in your lane on a multi-lane highway. Overtake slower vehicles from the right. Use indicators before changing lanes. Do not weave between lanes.
Hints: India drives on the LEFT — overtake from the RIGHT. | Stay in your lane unless overtaking. | Use indicators before every lane change. | Never weave between lanes — pick one and stick to it.

Title: Lesson 52 - Driving Instructor
Description: A structured driving lesson: change lanes to overtake a slow bus; then signal and merge back. Practice controlled lane changes with proper indicators.
Offense: Improper Overtaking / Lane Change Without Signal
Practical: Signal right; merge left to overtake the bus; then signal left and merge back to the right lane.
Hints: Always indicate before changing lanes. | Check mirrors and blind spots before merging. | Overtake on the right side (India drives on the left). | Merge back smoothly after passing the vehicle.
